cc_updates.body: The `/model` picker now lists models from your gateway's `/v1/models` endpoint when `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` points at an Anthropic-compatible gateway. Added `claude project purge [path]` to delete all Claude Code state for a project. `--dangerously-skip-permissions` now bypasses prompts for writes to `.claude/`, `.git/`, `.vscode/`, shell config files, and other previously-protected paths. `claude auth login` now accepts the OAuth code pasted into the terminal when the browser callback can't reach localhost. `claude_code.skill_activated` OpenTelemetry event now fires for user-typed slash commands. Auto mode: the spinner now turns red when a permission check stalls. Security: Fixed `allowManagedDomainsOnly` / `allowManagedReadPathsOnly` being ignored when a higher-priority managed-settings source lacked a `sandbox` block. Fixed pasting an image larger than 2000px breaking the session. Fixed OAuth login failing with timeout on slow or proxied connections.
Fixed OAuth authentication failing with a 401 retry loop when `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS=1` is set.

Added `ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_SERVICE_TIER` environment variable to select a Bedrock service tier (`default`, `flex`, or `priority`). Pasting a PR URL into the `/resume` search box now finds the session that created that PR. `/mcp` now shows claude.ai connectors hidden by a manually-added server with the same URL. OpenTelemetry: numeric attributes on `api_request`/`api_error` log events are now emitted as numbers. Fixed `/branch` producing forks that fail. Fixed `/model` not showing the Effort option for Bedrock application inference profile ARNs. Fixed Vertex AI / Bedrock returning `invalid_request_error`. Fixed images sent to newer models being resized to 2576px instead of 2000px maximum. Fixed remote control session idle status redrawing twice per second.
